name: hbm_hc_tail_child_k3b-k3b-COMMIT
purpose: H.STA.BLK.1 HC Sinkhorn tail child FALLBACK k3b (parallel with k3): TPIPE 1 + SKCE 1 + SDIV 12 + MCP 12, gate-level CLONED netlist. 440.64 x 293.76 (aspect 1.5), inputs on the long N face, outputs S, clk+rst_n W | SAFE checklist (FAM-HBM-B/HCTAIL 10-21, rebuilt after the k2b STRUCTURAL FAIL: Sinkhorn step 7.53 ns vs the 5.83 ns MCP7 budget, ~2,100 single-period tail paths ~38 levels -417 ps): 1 pins PASS (RTL pin flops + 2nd stage on every data pin; rst_n reset_landing 2 then ot_rst_relay 3 regions + kept leaf) | 2 reach: side <= 441 um, every pin->core hop registered; post-GRT 405 by gate | 3 fanout PASS: clone limit 24, native32 census on the mapped + retained netlist (README) | 4 depth: Sinkhorn step (7.53 ns measured on k2b) = DECLARED multicycle 12 between its own registers (10.0 ns budget, tailc_skmcp12.sdc); tail TPIPE 1: operand registers before every unit, mul_lat 9 / add_lat 7 / exp LM6 LA4 / fdiv 1 bit a stage, registered 2-level row max | 5 storage: no runtime-indexed flop array > 2 kb | 6 floorplan: no macros, util ~0.5 of synthesis area, full std-cell band | 7 clock: ONE root (clk), no derived clock; spread <=80 by --cts gate; io_hold_margin 0.03 | 8 schedule: static, no backpressure; child L 779 (+283 edges over L 496); the root's TAILC emit offset TE must grow by the same 283 edges (root xr4).
